subject: Auto Body Repairs and Spray Painting

subtopics.content: 1.1 - 1.6 Safety in auto body repairs and spray painting
subtopics.objective: Definition and list of safety rules, safety tools/equipment, personal protective equipment (dress code), sources of accidents and prevention, factory acts (Resource Conservation Recovery Act, EPA regulations, hazardous waste recycling).

subtopics.content: 2.1 - 2.8 Basic hand tools, spray painting tools, care and maintenance
subtopics.objective: Types and uses of hand tools (hammers, dollies, body spoons) and power tools (sanders, compressors, jacks). Spray painting tools (spray guns, ovens, spray booths). Types of maintenance (predictive, preventive, corrective), dismantling/assembly/cleaning of spray guns.

topics.title: Materials for Auto-body Repairs and Spray Painting

subtopics.content: 3.1 - 3.6 Body fillers, abrasives, sealers, rivets, paints
subtopics.objective: Identification of plastic/fibreglass fillers, body solder (30/70, 40/60), wet/dry sandpapers, sealers, pop/solid rivets. Enamel paints, lacquers, surface primers, putties, base colours, paint mixing formulas, and colour charts.

subtopics.content: 4.1 - 4.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals, properties, uses
subtopics.objective: Distinguish ferrous (mild steel, cast iron) and non-ferrous metals (aluminium, brass). Properties of metals (fusibility, malleability, ductility, weldability) and their application on vehicle auto bodies.
Definition and processes of heat treatment including hardening, annealing, normalizing, case-hardening, and tempering. Demonstrating heat treatment procedures and understanding their importance.

subtopics.content: 6.1 - 6.7 Oxy-acetylene welding setup, high/low pressure systems, defects
subtopics.objective: Safety precautions, equipment identification and assembly, high vs low pressure systems, welding nozzles, identification and remedies of weld defects (slag inclusion, porosity, cracking, lack of penetration).

subtopics.content: 7.1 - 7.8 Minor and major auto body repair
subtopics.objective: Integral vs composite body types. Straightening techniques using power jacks, sledgehammers, pry-bars, pull taps, and heat-shrinking. Major section repair (front, passenger, rear), alignment principles, quarter panel cutting, and lightweight panel repair.
Understanding specific steps involved in repairing, aligning, and restoring damaged aluminium auto panels and aluminium deck lids.

subtopics.content: 9.1 - 9.4 Working precautions, resin types, repair methods
subtopics.objective: Precautions when working with plastics. Distinguish thermosetting and thermoplastic resins. Repairing plastic parts by melting and introduction to glass fibre panel repair.

subtopics.content: 10.1 - 10.10 Guns, surface prep, paint types, metallic spray techniques
subtopics.objective: Pressure feed, siphon, and gravity spray guns and parts. Surface preparation steps. Types of paints (cellulose, synthetic, enamel, acrylic, metallic). Variable agents (flakes/pigments) and wet/dry metallic spray techniques.

subtopics.content: 11.1 - 11.2 Workshop setup considerations and equipment listing
subtopics.objective: Factors involved in locating an auto body repair shop (capital, accessibility, land) and compiling a complete tool/equipment inventory.
